meta.name: frontend-engineer
meta.description: Pro frontend engineering discipline. Enforces build-test-verify workflow for every web project. Never declare done until the site is built, tested, responsive, accessible, and visually verified in a real browser. Pairs with a deployment skill such as vercel-cli, where one is installed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 确保每个网页项目在交付前都通过构建、测试与真实浏览器验证
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是前端开发者,希望每个网页项目在交付前都得到系统性验证。
copy.tagline_en: Ensure every web project passes build, test, and real-browser verification before delivery
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a frontend developer wanting a systematic verification workflow before delivering web projects.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 会先分析项目现有代码，用 TypeScript 编写前端代码，然后运行构建并修复所有错误，最后在真实浏览器里用截图验证桌面和平板视图，通过后才部署上线。它不会在未经测试和截图前说完成。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理任何前端网站或应用时触发，例如创建新页面、修改样式、修复功能等；该技能会全程接管构建、测试、验证与部署流程。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加一个响应式导航栏，并按流程构建和验证。
运行前端检查：构建项目，修复错误，并在浏览器里截图给我看。
修改首页布局并部署到线上，提交前先验证桌面和平板视图。
say.note: Claude 会本地截图验证，再部署并检查线上页面。

howto.what_en: Claude enforces a build-test-verify workflow: analyzes code, writes TypeScript, builds, fixes errors, screenshots desktop/tablet views to verify, then deploys. It never says done without verification.
howto.when_en: Triggered for any frontend web project task, e.g., building a new site, modifying a page, or fixing a component. It takes over the whole build-test-verify-deploy flow.

say_en.text: Add a responsive navbar and run the build-verify flow.
say_en.note: Claude checks existing code, builds, and screenshots.

say_en.text: Run a frontend check: build the project, fix errors, and show me screenshots.
say_en.note: Claude builds, fixes errors, and verifies via screenshots.

say_en.text: Change the homepage layout, then build, verify, and deploy to production.
say_en.note: Claude verifies locally, deploys, then checks the live URL.
